acoustics.spl.title: Sound pressure level (re 20 µPa)
assumptions: p is the RMS sound pressure; p_ref = 20 µPa is the standard hearing-threshold reference.

acoustics.power_level.title: Sound power level (re 1 pW)
assumptions: W_ref = 1 pW is the standard reference for sound power.

acoustics.intensity_level.title: Sound intensity level (re 1 pW/m²)
assumptions: I_ref = 1 pW/m² is the standard reference intensity.

acoustics.pressure_intensity.title: Plane-wave relation between RMS sound pressure and intensity (I = p²/ρc)

variables.name: c
variables.desc: speed of sound in the medium

assumptions: Plane progressive wave (free field). In air at standard conditions ρc ≈ 400 rayl, so the intensity level and sound pressure level are numerically nearly equal.
method_references: I = p_rms²/(ρc) for a plane progressive wave

acoustics.add_levels.title: Add (combine) sound levels in dB

variables.name: levels
variables.desc: list of sound levels in dB

assumptions: Incoherent sources (energies add). Two equal levels add 3 dB; a level 10 dB below another adds only ~0.4 dB.

acoustics.wave_speed.title: Wave speed, frequency and wavelength (c = f·λ)

acoustics.mass_law.title: Sound transmission loss of a limp panel (normal-incidence mass law)

variables.name: rho_s
variables.desc: surface mass density of the panel
variables.label: ρs

variables.name: c
variables.desc: speed of sound in air (≈ 343 m/s)

assumptions: Limp, thin, uniform panel; normal incidence; below the coincidence frequency. The field-incidence empirical form is TL ≈ 20 log10(f·ρs) − 47 dB.
method_references: Normal-incidence mass law: TL = 10 log10(1 + (π f ρs/ρc)²)

acoustics.noise_reduction.title: Noise reduction between two rooms (level difference)

acoustics.room_noise_reduction.title: Room-to-room noise reduction from transmission loss and absorption

variables.name: A
variables.desc: total absorption in the receiving room (sabins)

assumptions: Diffuse field in the receiving room; A in metric sabins (m²).

acoustics.reverberation_sabine.title: Reverberation time (Sabine)

variables.name: T60
variables.desc: reverberation time (time for sound to decay 60 dB)

assumptions: Diffuse field, uniform absorption. The constant is 0.161 s/m in SI (0.049 s/ft imperial).

acoustics.total_absorption.title: Total absorption of a room (Σ α·S)

acoustics.a_weighting.title: A-weighting of a frequency (IEC 61672 analytic form)

variables.name: A
variables.desc: A-weighting at this frequency in dB

assumptions: Analytic IEC 61672 transfer function with rounded pole frequencies 20.6, 107.7, 737.9 and 12194 Hz (recalled). A(1000 Hz) = 0 dB by definition.
method_references: IEC 61672-1 A-weighting transfer function (poles recalled, not re-read)

acoustics.noise_dose.title: Noise-exposure dose and time-weighted average (OSHA or NIOSH/ISO)

variables.name: levels
variables.desc: list of exposure levels in dB(A)

variables.name: durations
variables.desc: list of exposure durations in hours (same order as levels)

variables.name: exchange_rate
variables.desc: exchange rate (5 dB OSHA, 3 dB NIOSH/ISO)
variables.label: Q

variables.name: criterion
variables.desc: criterion level (90 dBA OSHA, 85 dBA NIOSH/ISO)
variables.label: Lc

variables.name: dose
variables.desc: noise dose in percent (100 % = full allowed exposure)

procedure.python:
def _noise_dose(values):
    """OSHA or NIOSH/ISO noise-exposure dose and time-weighted average.

    Reference duration for a level L: T = 8 h / 2^((L - criterion)/exchange_rate). Dose = 100 sum(C/T).
    TWA = criterion + exchange_rate * log2(dose/100). OSHA: 5 dB exchange, 90 dBA criterion;
    NIOSH/ISO: 3 dB exchange, 85 dBA criterion. Every entered level is counted (no threshold is applied).
    """
    standard = values['standard']
    er, crit = (5.0, 90.0) if standard == 'OSHA' else (3.0, 85.0)
    levels = values['levels']
    durations = values['durations']
    if not isinstance(levels, list) or not isinstance(durations, list) or not levels \
            or len(levels) != len(durations):
        raise MechError('levels/durations: give matching non-empty lists of level [dB] and duration [h]')
    for L in levels:
        _number(L, 'levels')  # reject non-numeric level entries
    for C in durations:
        C = _number(C, 'durations')
        if C < 0:
            raise MechError('durations: negative durations are not allowed')
    dose = 0.0
    for L, C in zip(levels, durations):
        T = 8.0 / (2.0 ** ((float(L) - crit) / er))
        dose += float(C) / T
    dose *= 100.0
    if dose <= 0:
        raise MechError('total exposure is zero (dose = 0); TWA is undefined')
    twa = crit + er * math.log2(dose / 100.0)
    return {'exchange_rate': er, 'criterion': crit, 'dose': dose, 'twa': twa}

assumptions: OSHA: 5 dB exchange rate, 90 dBA criterion, 8 h reference. NIOSH/ISO: 3 dB exchange rate, 85 dBA criterion. Reference duration T = 8 h / 2^((L − criterion)/exchange_rate). Every entered level is counted — no threshold (OSHA 80/90 dBA) is applied.
The "3 dB / 85 dBA" convention is the NIOSH/ISO criterion.
method_references: Dose = 100 Σ(Ci/Ti); TWA = criterion + Q·log2(dose/100) (OSHA/NIOSH/ISO conventions)

source.derivation: Two equal levels add 3 dB: 80 + 10 log10(2) = 80 + 3.0103 = 83.010 dB
A(1 kHz) = 0 dB by definition of the A-weighting (rounded pole frequencies give ~0.0001 dB)
NIOSH/ISO: T = 8/2^0 = 8 h; dose = 100 %; TWA = 85 dB
